name: P006-1

commands: ls -la
find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -name "*.ts"
cat package.json
ls docs contracts tests
cat README.md
ls docs
ls contracts
ls -la && echo "---" && git status && echo "---" && git log --oneline -5 2>&1 | head -20
find . -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' | sort && echo "---README---" && cat README.md && echo "---package.json---" && cat package.json

grep -rn "expiresAt\|sessions\|authenticate\|session\|token" --include=*.ts --include=*.json --include=*.md --include=*.py -l . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules; echo "=== occurrences ==="; grep -rn "expiresAt\|sessions\|authenticate" --include=*.ts --include=*.md . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules
node --version; echo "---"; ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- can we run TS? ---"; node -e "console.log(process.execPath)"

cat .git; echo "--- baseline checksums ---"; find . -type f -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.py' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.md' | grep -v node_modules | sort | xargs shasum -a 256 | tee /tmp/auth_audit_baseline.sha256 | wc -l; echo "--- npm test (baseline) ---"; npm test 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "TEST_EXIT=$?"
awk 'NR{printf "%d\t%s\n", NR, $0}' server/auth.ts; echo "--- byte count / lines ---"; wc -lc server/auth.ts
grep -rn "expiresAt\|sessions\|authenticate" --include=*.ts --include=*.md . ; echo "EXIT=$?"
grep -rn --include=*.ts --exclude-dir=reports "expiresAt\|sessions\|authenticate" . ; echo "EXIT=$?"

shasum -a 256 -c /tmp/auth_audit_baseline.sha256 2>&1; echo "VERIFY_EXIT=$?"; echo "--- files now present ---"; ls -R reports; echo "--- npm test after report ---"; npm test 2>&1 | tail -8; rm -f /tmp/auth_audit_baseline.sha256
ls -la; ls server/ 2>/dev/null; wc -l server/storage.ts
cat server/storage.ts; echo ---; cat server/config.ts; echo ---; cat server/users.ts; echo ---; cat package.json; echo ---; ls tests; cat tests/*.test.js | head -100
find contracts src docs clients web tests -type f | head -50; echo ---; cat README.md
grep -rn "storage\|save(" --include="*.ts" --include="*.json" -l . | grep -v node_modules; echo ---; cat src/importer.ts src/settings.ts contracts/users.json docs/configuration.md
node --version; git -C . status --porcelain; git log --oneline -3

f=$(mktemp /tmp/audit-rlimit.XXXXXX)
printf 'PRECIOUS-ORIGINAL-DATA' > "$f"
echo "initial size: $(stat -f%z "$f")"
( ulimit -f 100; node --input-type=module -e 'import { save } from process.env.PWD + "/server/storage.ts"; save(process.argv[1], "X".repeat(200000000));' "$f" )
echo "node exit status: $?"
echo "final size after RLIMIT_FSIZE failure: $(stat -f%z "$f")"
echo "first 20 bytes: $(head -c 20 "$f")"
cmp -s "$f" <(printf 'PRECIOUS-ORIGINAL-DATA') && echo "old data intact" || echo "OLD DATA DESTROYED / FILE PARTIAL"
rm -f "$f"

f=$(mktemp /tmp/audit-rlimit.XXXXXX)
printf 'PRECIOUS-ORIGINAL-DATA' > "$f"
echo "initial size: $(stat -f%z "$f")"
( ulimit -f 100; node --input-type=module -e 'const { save } = await import("file://" + process.env.PWD + "/server/storage.ts"); save(process.argv[1], "X".repeat(200000000));' "$f" )
echo "node exit status: $?"
echo "final size after RLIMIT_FSIZE failure: $(stat -f%z "$f")"
echo "first 20 bytes: [$(head -c 20 "$f")]"
rm -f "$f"

f=$(mktemp /tmp/audit-rlimit.XXXXXX)
printf 'PRECIOUS-ORIGINAL-DATA' > "$f"
echo "initial size: $(stat -f%z "$f")"
( ulimit -f 100; node --input-type=module -e 'const { save } = await import("file://" + process.env.PWD + "/server/storage.ts"); save(process.argv[1], "X".repeat(200000000));' "$f" > /dev/null 2>&1 ) || echo "node exit status: $?"
echo "final size after mid-write EFBIG failure: $(stat -f%z "$f")"
echo "expected complete payload size: 200000000"
echo "first 22 bytes: [$(head -c 22 "$f")]"
rm -f "$f"
grep -nE "fsync|datasync|flush|rename|tmp|lock|throw|try|catch" server/storage.ts; echo "grep exit=$?"

cat server/storage.ts; echo ---; md5 server/storage.ts server/config.ts server/users.ts src/*.ts web/*.ts clients/*/* contracts/* tests/* 2>/dev/null | head -20; git status --porcelain 2>&1 | head -5; ls reports 2>/dev/null || echo "no reports dir yet"
wc -l reports/storage.md; ls -la reports; cat server/storage.ts
ls -la; ls reports/ 2>/dev/null; git status --short | head
find . -type f -not -path './.git*' | sort | xargs shasum -a 256 > /tmp/release_baseline.sha256; wc -l < /tmp/release_baseline.sha256; echo "EXIT=$?"
cat -n server/auth.ts server/storage.ts src/settings.ts server/config.ts
npm test; echo "EXIT=$?"
grep -rn --include=*.ts --exclude-dir=reports "expiresAt\|sessions\|authenticate" . ; echo "EXIT=$?"; grep -rn "save(\|storage" --include=*.ts --exclude-dir=reports . ; echo "EXIT2=$?"

f=$(mktemp /tmp/rel-efbig.XXXXXX); printf 'PRECIOUS-ORIGINAL-DATA' > "$f"
echo "initial size: $(stat -f%z "$f")"
( ulimit -f 100; node --input-type=module -e 'const { save } = await import("file://" + process.env.PWD + "/server/storage.ts"); save(process.argv[1], "X".repeat(200000000));' "$f" > /dev/null 2>&1 ) ; echo "node exit status: $?"
echo "final size: $(stat -f%z "$f")"
echo "first 22 bytes: [$(head -c 22 "$f")]"
rm -f "$f"

f=$(mktemp /tmp/rel-efbig.XXXXXX); printf 'PRECIOUS-ORIGINAL-DATA' > "$f"
echo "initial size: $(stat -f%z "$f")"
( trap '' XFSZ; ulimit -f 100; node --input-type=module -e 'const { save } = await import("file://" + process.env.PWD + "/server/storage.ts"); save(process.argv[1], "X".repeat(200000000));' "$f" > /tmp/rel-efbig.err 2>&1; echo "node exit status: $?" )
echo "final size: $(stat -f%z "$f")"
echo "first 22 bytes: [$(head -c 22 "$f")]"
head -3 /tmp/rel-efbig.err
rm -f "$f" /tmp/rel-efbig.err
rm /tmp/rel_efbig.sh
bash scratch/rel_efbig.sh "$PWD/server/storage.ts"; echo "script exit=$?"
bash scratch/rel_efbig.sh "$PWD/server/storage.ts"; echo "script exit=$?"

f=$(mktemp /tmp/dbg.XXXXXX); printf 'OLD' > "$f"; ls -l "$f"
STORAGE_TS_URL="file://$PWD/server/storage.ts" node scratch/efbig.mjs "$f"; echo "exit=$?"
ls -l "$f"; rm -f "$f"

f=$(mktemp /tmp/dbg2.XXXXXX); printf 'PRECIOUS-ORIGINAL-DATA' > "$f"
bash -c '
trap "" XFSZ
ulimit -f 100
STORAGE_TS_URL="file://'"$PWD"'/server/storage.ts" node '"$PWD"'/scratch/efbig.mjs "$1"
echo "node exit=$?"
echo "size in child: $(stat -f%z "$1")"
' "$f"
echo "final size: $(stat -f%z "$f")"
echo "first 22: [$(head -c 22 "$f")]"
rm -f "$f"
